engine_cli_smoke case-16 abort (cannot multiply/subtract non-numeric operand tag 24) ROOT-CAUSED to a hexa 0.1.0-dispatch TOOLCHAIN codegen bug, NOT an anima engine bug — UNFIXABLE in anima (a_break_the_wall taxonomy-c substrate/infra wall -> hexa-lang). BUG: a [float]/[int] array passed as a FUNCTION PARAMETER then indexed returns mistyped/garbage elements; the smoke hits it the first time case 16 enters immune_grow_bind -> _vnearest_idx -> _l2(a:[float],b:[float]) at d=a[i]-b[i]. MINIMAL NO-IMPORT REPRO (reproduces on summer AND aiden, same hexa.real build, AND May-25 backup binary -> long-standing not a regression): (1) fn l2(a:[float],b:[float])->float{let d=a[0]-b[0];return d}; fn main(){println(str(l2([1.0,0.0],[0.0,1.0])))} -> 'cannot subtract non-numeric operand (tag 24 - tag 0)'. (2) fn f(a:[int])->int{return a[0]+a[1]}; fn main(){println(str(f([3,4])))} -> SEGFAULT. (3) fn main(){let x=[5.0,6.0];println(str(x[0]))} -> 4618441417868443648 (5.0 bits) not 5.0. Workaround that already works: read array elems via an intermediate let in the SAME scope before arithmetic (that's why brain_smoke RC=0 — it never crosses a numeric array through a fn-param then indexes). FOLLOW-ON: file repro to hexa-lang (numeric array-param element-read mistyping in 0.1.0-dispatch codegen); once fixed, engine_cli_smoke cases 16+ should pass with NO anima source change (engine _l2/_vnearest_idx/immune_grow_bind are correct). Captured: engine_cli_smoke RC=1, brain_smoke RC=0. See CHANGELOG 2026-06-17 substrate(engine_cli_smoke) entry.
